summary_1line: Rama, devastated by Sita’s disappearance, laments his fate, imagines her suffering or death, and appeals to nature for answers while Lakshmana prepares to console him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands in the forest by the Godavari, raising his arms to the sun and wind as he cries out for news of the vanished Sita.
Rama, pale with grief, imagines Sita carried through the sky by a demon while she cries helplessly below the dark clouds.
Rama wanders the forest in despair while Lakshmana follows behind him, his face stricken with fear and sorrow.
